data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic root 'al', meaning 'light'. In old Slavic folklore, Alenka was a goddess of the dawn and the sun. In Christianity, it is a name given to girls to symbolize light and brightness. The name Alenka carries the meaning “Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alenka usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
